shipping.title: Shipping
body: We ship across India. Every piece is dispatched within 2–4 working days in a Nemara pouch with its story card.
Shipping is free on orders over ₹2,500. Below that, a flat ₹99 applies.
Metro deliveries typically take 2–4 days after dispatch; other locations 4–7 days. You'll receive tracking by email and WhatsApp.
International shipping is coming soon. Write to us if you'd like to be told first.

returns.title: Returns & exchanges
body: If a piece isn't right, return it unworn, with its tags and packaging, within 7 days of delivery for a refund or exchange.
For hygiene, earrings can only be returned if they arrive faulty.
Start a return by writing to us on WhatsApp or email with your order number. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5–7 working days of the piece reaching us.

care.title: Caring for your Nemara
body: Put your jewellery on last and take it off first: after perfume, lotion and hairspray, and before you shower, swim or exercise.
Wipe each piece with the Nemara cloth after wearing and store it in its pouch, away from moisture.
Sterling silver naturally tarnishes over time; a gentle polish with the cloth restores it. Avoid chemical dips on enamel and filigree.
Plating can wear with friction. If a favourite piece needs care, write to us — we offer re-plating for a small fee.

size-guide.title: Kada size guide
body: Kada sizes are measured by inner diameter in inches, using the traditional Indian scale.
2.4 — inner diameter about 5.7 cm: petite hands and narrower wrists.
2.6 — inner diameter about 6.0 cm: the most common size.
2.8 — inner diameter about 6.4 cm: broader hands, or a looser fit.
To check: measure the inside of a bangle you already wear, or ask us on WhatsApp — we'll help you choose.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: This policy is a placeholder and must be reviewed by a qualified professional before launch.
We collect only what we need to fulfil your order and talk to you: your name, contact details, delivery address and order history.
Payments are processed by our payment partner; Nemara never sees or stores your card or UPI credentials.
Try-on runs entirely in your browser. Camera images are never uploaded or stored by Nemara.
We use privacy-friendly analytics to understand how the site is used. With your consent, we may also use advertising pixels.
To access or delete your data, write to us at the email address on our Contact page.
